# Krupashindu - Turnkey Beverage & Mineral Water Plant Solutions

Krupashindu (Krupashindu Consulting Engineers) is a premier ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, exporter, and technical consultant specializing in turnkey solutions for the mineral water and beverage industries. Headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India, Krupashindu delivers custom-engineered production lines, water purification systems, and bottling machinery to entrepreneurs and enterprises globally across 30+ countries.

## Core Turnkey Machinery & Products
1. **Mineral Water Plant:** Complete multi-stage purification and bottling setups (2,000 to 20,000 BPH) designed for BIS/ISI/FSSAI compliance.
2. **Fruit Juice Plant:** Integrated pulp extraction, blending, hot-fill pasteurization, and aseptic filling lines.
3. **Soft Drink Plant:** Advanced CSD (Carbonated Soft Drink) lines equipped with high-pressure CO2 carbonators and counter-pressure fillers.
4. **Bottled Water Plant:** Monoblock Rinsing-Filling-Capping (RFC) machines optimizing energy efficiency and layout footprint.
5. **Industrial RO Plant & Water Softener:** High-recovery reverse osmosis systems utilizing premium FRP/SS pressure vessels and TDS control.
6. **Blow Molding Machinery:** Semi-automatic and fully automatic servo-driven PET bottle blow molders with infrared preheating.
7. **End-of-Line Packaging:** Fully automatic shrink wrappers, automatic labeling machines (sleeve/sticker/wrap-around), case packers, and robotic palletizers.

## Turnkey Services & Engineering Support
- **Site Layout & Planning:** Designing clean-room environments to meet stringent ISI/BIS regulatory hygiene standards.
- **BIS (ISI) & FSSAI Licensing Assistance:** Guided consulting on regulatory paperwork, standard testing labs, and audit preparation.
- **Installation & Commissioning:** On-site mechanical, piping, and electrical integration by expert engineers.
- **After-Sales Support:** Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), 24/7 technical helpdesk, genuine spare parts inventory, and remote video troubleshooting.
